dimensions.assessment: Affects small business concerns seeking federal contract opportunities and federal agencies publishing procurement notices.
dimensions.evidence: a notice pertaining to small business concerns published by a Federal agency

dimensions.assessment: Administrative change regarding formatting and clarity of contracting notices rather than altering underlying contract awards or substantive rights.
dimensions.evidence: Each covered notice shall be written in a manner... easily understand the intent

dimensions.assessment: Explicitly prohibits the authorization of any additional funds to carry out the requirements.
dimensions.evidence: No additional funds are authorized to carry out the requirements of this Act.

dimensions.assessment: Requires new administrative guidelines and SBA rulemaking for federal contracting notices.
dimensions.evidence: Administrator of the Small Business Administration shall issue rules to carry out this section

dimensions.assessment: Imposes permanent notice-writing standards on federal agencies.

missing_information: Details on the administrative costs absorbed by agencies to comply without additional funds.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill requires federal agencies to write small business contracting notices in clear, concise, accessible language following the Plain Writing Act of 2010, with rules issued by the Small Business Administration within 90 days, without authorizing additional funds.
